stories.title: Welsh Government announces £145 million for NHS Wales to cut waiting times
stories.summary: The Welsh Government has announced £145 million in extra funding for NHS Wales this financial year, with reducing waiting times named as the immediate priority. stories.title: Chester Zoo welcomes rare male giraffe to join conservation breeding programme
stories.summary: Chester Zoo has introduced a three-year-old male northern giraffe named Kris to its resident female herd as part of a conservation breeding programme for one of Africa’s most endangered large animals. stories.title: Nearly 24,500 Flintshire households claiming single person council tax discount face annual check
stories.summary: Nearly 24,500 Flintshire households claiming a single person discount on their council tax will be checked from July to confirm they are entitled to the reduction. stories.title: Lottery bid decision in December will determine fate of £13m Flintshire and Denbighshire archive plan
